mapper.select: select a.id as activityId, a.title as activityTitle, count(e.id) as enrollCount, count(s.id) as signCount from activity a left join activity_enroll e on a.id = e.activity_id left join activity_sign s on a.id = s.activity_id where a.club_id = #{clubId} group by a.id,a.title
select (select count(1) from activity) as totalActivity, (select count(1) from activity_enroll) as totalEnroll, (select count(1) from sys_club) as totalClub
